result.brief: 总结 Kling 视频生成背后的多模态理解栈：共享多模态基础模型 Kling-MLLM、语义契约式描述、感知训练得到的文本编码器与奖励建模，为可控视频生成提供理解侧经验。
result.reason: Report on Kling's shared multimodal foundation model (Kling-MLLM) unifying image/video/audio inputs, captioning as semantic contract, text encoder and reward modeling for video generation.
